summary: Preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated payload via Bun
details: The package declares a `preinstall` hook (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscator.io-style (hex-named identifiers, per-function string maps) and downloads the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/...`, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a bundled `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB `@bun-cjs` file with heavy obfuscator.io shape (rotating string array `n7gIxM`, shifter `WV8StW`, decoder `hc1jfK9`) and has no counterpart source in `src/`. The package advertises itself as a browser AJAX utility library, which has no legitimate need for a second language runtime or an opaque install-time payload. The result is arbitrary code execution on the installer's host via Bun at `npm install` time, deliberately routed around Node-based inspection.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
